verses.ar: اَلِٱبْنُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ يَقْبَلُ تَأْدِيبَ أَبِيهِ، وَٱلْمُسْتَهْزِئُ لَا يَسْمَعُ ٱنْتِهَارًا.
verses.kjv: A wise son [heareth] his father’s instruction: but a scorner heareth not rebuke.
verses.web: A wise son listens to his father’s instruction, but a scoffer doesn’t listen to rebuke.

verses.ar: مِنْ ثَمَرَةِ فَمِهِ يَأْكُلُ ٱلْإِنْسَانُ خَيْرًا، وَمَرَامُ ٱلْغَادِرِينَ ظُلْمٌ.
verses.kjv: A man shall eat good by the fruit of [his] mouth: but the soul of the transgressors [shall eat] violence.
verses.web: By the fruit of his lips, a man enjoys good things, but the unfaithful crave violence.

verses.ar: مَنْ يَحْفَظُ فَمَهُ يَحْفَظُ نَفْسَهُ. مَنْ يَشْحَرْ شَفَتَيْهِ فَلَهُ هَلَاكٌ.
verses.kjv: He that keepeth his mouth keepeth his life: [but] he that openeth wide his lips shall have destruction.
verses.web: He who guards his mouth guards his soul. One who opens wide his lips comes to ruin.

verses.ar: نَفْسُ ٱلْكَسْلَانِ تَشْتَهِي وَلَا شَيْءَ لَهَا، وَنَفْسُ ٱلْمُجْتَهِدِينَ تَسْمَنُ.
verses.kjv: The soul of the sluggard desireth, and [hath] nothing: but the soul of the diligent shall be made fat.
verses.web: The soul of the sluggard desires, and has nothing, but the desire of the diligent shall be fully satisfied.

verses.ar: اَلصِّدِّيقُ يُبْغِضُ كَلَامَ كَذِبٍ، وَٱلشِّرِّيرُ يُخْزِي وَيُخْجِلُ.
verses.kjv: A righteous [man] hateth lying: but a wicked [man] is loathsome, and cometh to shame.
verses.web: A righteous man hates lies, but a wicked man brings shame and disgrace.

verses.ar: اَلْبِرُّ يَحْفَظُ ٱلْكَامِلَ طَرِيقَهُ، وَٱلشَّرُّ يَقْلِبُ ٱلْخَاطِئَ.
verses.kjv: Righteousness keepeth [him that is] upright in the way: but wickedness overthroweth the sinner.
verses.web: Righteousness guards the way of integrity, but wickedness overthrows the sinner.

verses.ar: يُوجَدُ مَنْ يَتَغَانَى وَلَا شَيْءَ عِنْدَهُ، وَمَنْ يَتَفَاقَرُ وَعِنْدَهُ غِنًى جَزِيلٌ.
verses.kjv: There is that maketh himself rich, yet [hath] nothing: [there is] that maketh himself poor, yet [hath] great riches.
verses.web: There are some who pretend to be rich, yet have nothing. There are some who pretend to be poor, yet have great wealth.

verses.ar: فِدْيَةُ نَفْسِ رَجُلٍ غِنَاهُ، أَمَّا ٱلْفَقِيرُ فَلَا يَسْمَعُ ٱنْتِهَارًا.
verses.kjv: The ransom of a man’s life [are] his riches: but the poor heareth not rebuke.
verses.web: The ransom of a man’s life is his riches, but the poor hear no threats.

verses.ar: نُورُ ٱلصِّدِّيقِينَ يُفَرِّحُ، وَسِرَاجُ ٱلْأَشْرَارِ يَنْطَفِئُ.
verses.kjv: The light of the righteous rejoiceth: but the lamp of the wicked shall be put out.
verses.web: The light of the righteous shines brightly, but the lamp of the wicked is snuffed out.

verses.ar: اَلْخِصَامُ إِنَّمَا يَصِيرُ بِٱلْكِبْرِيَاءِ، وَمَعَ ٱلْمُتَشَاوِرِينَ حِكْمَةٌ.
verses.kjv: Only by pride cometh contention: but with the well advised [is] wisdom.
verses.web: Pride only breeds quarrels, but wisdom is with people who take advice.

verses.ar: غِنَى ٱلْبُطْلِ يَقِلُّ، وَٱلْجَامِعُ بِيَدِهِ يَزْدَادُ.
verses.kjv: Wealth [gotten] by vanity shall be diminished: but he that gathereth by labour shall increase.
verses.web: Wealth gained dishonestly dwindles away, but he who gathers by hand makes it grow.

verses.ar: ٱلرَّجَاءُ ٱلْمُمَاطَلُ يُمْرِضُ ٱلْقَلْبَ، وَٱلشَّهْوَةُ ٱلْمُتَمَّمَةُ شَجَرَةُ حَيَاةٍ.
verses.kjv: Hope deferred maketh the heart sick: but [when] the desire cometh, [it is] a tree of life.
verses.web: Hope deferred makes the heart sick, but when longing is fulfilled, it is a tree of life.

verses.ar: مَنِ ٱزْدَرَى بِٱلْكَلِمَةِ يُخْرِبُ نَفْسَهُ، وَمَنْ خَشِيَ ٱلْوَصِيَّةَ يُكَافَأُ.
verses.kjv: Whoso despiseth the word shall be destroyed: but he that feareth the commandment shall be rewarded.
verses.web: Whoever despises instruction will pay for it, but he who respects a command will be rewarded.

verses.ar: شَرِيعَةُ ٱلْحَكِيمِ يَنْبُوعُ حَيَاةٍ لِلْحَيَدَانِ عَنْ أَشْرَاكِ ٱلْمَوْتِ.
verses.kjv: The law of the wise [is] a fountain of life, to depart from the snares of death.
verses.web: The teaching of the wise is a spring of life, to turn from the snares of death.

verses.ar: اَلْفِطْنَةُ ٱلْجَيِّدَةُ تَمْنَحُ نِعْمَةً، أَمَّا طَرِيقُ ٱلْغَادِرِينَ فَأَوْعَرُ.
verses.kjv: Good understanding giveth favour: but the way of transgressors [is] hard.
verses.web: Good understanding wins favor, but the way of the unfaithful is hard.

verses.ar: كُلُّ ذَكِيٍّ يَعْمَلُ بِٱلْمَعْرِفَةِ، وَٱلْجَاهِلُ يَنْشُرُ حُمْقًا.
verses.kjv: Every prudent [man] dealeth with knowledge: but a fool layeth open [his] folly.
verses.web: Every prudent man acts from knowledge, but a fool exposes folly.

verses.ar: اَلرَّسُولُ ٱلشِّرِّيرُ يَقَعُ فِي ٱلشَّرِّ، وَٱلسَّفِيرُ ٱلْأَمِينُ شِفَاءٌ.
verses.kjv: A wicked messenger falleth into mischief: but a faithful ambassador [is] health.
verses.web: A wicked messenger falls into trouble, but a trustworthy envoy gains healing.

verses.ar: فَقْرٌ وَهَوَانٌ لِمَنْ يَرْفُضُ ٱلتَّأْدِيبَ، وَمَنْ يُلَاحِظ ٱلتَّوْبِيخَ يُكْرَمْ.
verses.kjv: Poverty and shame [shall be to] him that refuseth instruction: but he that regardeth reproof shall be honoured.
verses.web: Poverty and shame come to him who refuses discipline, but he who heeds correction shall be honored.

verses.ar: اَلشَّهْوَةُ ٱلْحَاصِلَةُ تَلُذُّ ٱلنَّفْسَ، أَمَّا كَرَاهَةُ ٱلْجُهَّالِ فَهِيَ ٱلْحَيَدَانُ عَنِ ٱلشَّرِّ.
verses.kjv: The desire accomplished is sweet to the soul: but [it is] abomination to fools to depart from evil.
verses.web: Longing fulfilled is sweet to the soul, but fools detest turning from evil.

verses.ar: اَلْمُسَايِرُ ٱلْحُكَمَاءَ يَصِيرُ حَكِيمًا، وَرَفِيقُ ٱلْجُهَّالِ يُضَرُّ.
verses.kjv: He that walketh with wise [men] shall be wise: but a companion of fools shall be destroyed.
verses.web: One who walks with wise men grows wise, but a companion of fools suffers harm.

verses.ar: اَلشَّرُّ يَتْبَعُ ٱلْخَاطِئِينَ، وَٱلصِّدِّيقُونَ يُجَازَوْنَ خَيْرًا.
verses.kjv: Evil pursueth sinners: but to the righteous good shall be repayed.
verses.web: Misfortune pursues sinners, but prosperity rewards the righteous.

verses.ar: اَلصَّالِحُ يُورِثُ بَنِي ٱلْبَنِينَ، وَثَرْوَةُ ٱلْخَاطِئِ تُذْخَرُ لِلصِّدِّيقِ.
verses.kjv: A good [man] leaveth an inheritance to his children’s children: and the wealth of the sinner [is] laid up for the just.
verses.web: A good man leaves an inheritance to his children’s children, but the wealth of the sinner is stored for the righteous.

verses.ar: فِي حَرْثِ ٱلْفُقَرَاءِ طَعَامٌ كَثِيرٌ، وَيُوجَدُ هَالِكٌ مِنْ عَدَمِ ٱلْحَقِّ.
verses.kjv: Much food [is in] the tillage of the poor: but there is [that is] destroyed for want of judgment.
verses.web: An abundance of food is in poor people’s fields, but injustice sweeps it away.

verses.ar: مَنْ يَمْنَعُ عَصَاهُ يَمْقُتِ ٱبْنَهُ، وَمَنْ أَحَبَّهُ يَطْلُبُ لَهُ ٱلتَّأْدِيبَ.
verses.kjv: He that spareth his rod hateth his son: but he that loveth him chasteneth him betimes.
verses.web: One who spares the rod hates his son, but one who loves him is careful to discipline him.

verses.ar: اَلصِّدِّيقُ يَأْكُلُ لِشَبَعِ نَفْسِهِ، أَمَّا بَطْنُ ٱلْأَشْرَارِ فَيَحْتَاجُ.
verses.kjv: The righteous eateth to the satisfying of his soul: but the belly of the wicked shall want.
verses.web: The righteous one eats to the satisfying of his soul, but the belly of the wicked goes hungry.
